rows.en:
I-Insolent creature! Get this filthy tongue off me! …!?

Th-that is!?
Great King Gamagon is sensitive to light! He can sense even the faintest light… and the Iga Crystal is no exception.

Then…!?

So this really is…!? The Iga Crystal?

Well done, Raider!

I thought you had gone missing, but to think… you'd come back with the Iga Crystal in hand…!

However, there is one more thing that worries me…
If it's Sharivan, please, leave him to me!

(That Demon King… he's caught on to my scheme, hasn't he?

That's why he passed over Doctor Polter and ordered me to hunt down Sharivan…

If we kill each other, so much the better… that's what he's thinking!

I have the Iga Crystal. If I make use of Great King Gamagon… this is my chance! Heh heh heh…)
I'll team up with Great King Gamagon… and strike down that Sharivan!
Let's go! Great King Gamagon, we have work to do!
I find it shameful… Why those two?
Those two cannot be trusted… I sense some pitch-black scheme!
Hurry and build the energy generator! Once I make the Iga Crystal's power my own, disposing of those two will be nothing!
Yes, sir… I will begin building the device at once!
Demon King! Give me power! The power to defeat the Space Sheriffs…!
Nuooooooh! I w-wanted to get married before I diiied!
Heh heh heh… Have you come out to die, Sharivan?
I'll show you the way to hell! Great King Gamagon!
Heh heh heh… The Iga Crystal is mine!

That's impossible!?

Why, Holy One? Why won't you help me at such a crucial time?

Damn it! I'll take it back, I swear! I swear it! The Iga Crystal is needed for the revival of Planet Iga, too.

That's impossible!?

Why, Holy One? Why won't you help me at such a crucial time?

Damn it! I'll take it back, I swear! I swear it! The Iga Crystal is needed for the revival of Planet Iga, too.

Heh heh heh… Try and take it!

Now that the groom is dead… I have no more use for that girl either! What will you do, Space Sheriffs…
The time is ripe… Genmu Castle is mine!
The Demon King has lost his power…
Nngh… You think you can defy me!?

Holy One…

Why do you remain silent? Why? Why won't you lend me your hand? Why did you let it fall into Madou's hands…

Holy One…

Why do you remain silent? Why? Why won't you lend me your hand? Why did you let it fall into Madou's hands…
Hurry to Demon King Psycho! The Iga Crystal is there…
Please tell me! Why couldn't you protect the Iga Crystal for us?
Please tell me! Why couldn't you protect the Iga Crystal for us?
Complete the energy generator, and build the Eternal Kingdom!

Kyaooo!

I am immortal, Raider! I hold my life split in two… I've seen your scheme in full!

Raider! Do not underestimate Demon King Psycho, ruler of the universe!
Nuooooooh! Curse you, when I was just one step away…
Everything has gone as I planned! All that remains is Sharivan…!

The Iga Crystal is in Genmu Castle!

Once you are taken care of, our Madou will go on blooming as a flower of evil, an Eternal Kingdom!
I'll defeat Madou! I'll take back the Iga Crystal! Give Mimi back!
I'll defeat Madou! I'll take back the Iga Crystal! Give Mimi back!
We hold our life split in two… Even if one of us falls, the other can pour life into it!
The time has come to settle my long-held grudge…
Is he a monster? Is he really immortal!?
Is he a monster? Is he really immortal!?

uncertain: U12262: Polter is licked by Gamagon's tongue, which reveals the Iga Crystal.
U12267: 殺ってくれ - Psycho asks Raider to kill Sharivan.
U12274: Polter is upset that Psycho chose Raider and Gamagon over him.
U12280: Guiler's comic death line kept.
U12284: 事内 read as 案内 "show you the way".
U12291: 節季は熟した read as 時は熟した "The time is ripe".
U12312/U12313: 正体 of the Holy One; "its" used since gender is not settled.
U12314/U12330: 万年王国 rendered "Eternal Kingdom"; 薬き read as 築き, 鏡ける as 続ける.
U12316/U12318: speaker Suspicious Man is Demon King Psycho in disguise (he names himself).
U12321-U12322: Psycholer's roar continues in a narration-kind row.
U12335: 命を二つに分けて持つ - Psycho and Psycholer share one life split in two.
